verdict.rationale: The SDK provides permission controls (permission modes, rules, canUseTool callback) and hooks to block operations, which allow scoping what tools/actions an agent can use, but this governs tool invocation rather than issuing scoped/least-privilege API credentials (e.g., API keys with restricted scopes) for the agent itself. There is no evidence of credential-scoping mechanisms tied to API key issuance. missing for 10: dedicated scoped/least-privilege API key or credential issuance mechanism, documentation on generating restricted-scope tokens per agent, independent verification of credential scoping in production deployments.
